text:
Alice: Heads-up — noticed a large credit on the March invoice: `-48,230.00 USD` labeled 'Accelerator usage adjustment'. Not in our forecast or commit offsets. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
invoice-bot: New invoice uploaded: invoice-2026-03 | total_before_credits: 512,340.00 | total_after_credits: 464,110.00
Ben: I see a line: `Adjustment: accelerator-rate-change-credit` with `-48,230.00`. Could be provider algorithmic repricing, but that amount is odd.
Claire: Did we have any reservation cancellations or refunded commitments? I checked reserved instance adjustments and nothing matching that amount.
Diego: Ran `gcloud billing accounts transactions list --start-time=2026-03-01 --end-time=2026-03-31 | grep accelerator` and got this snippet: ```2026-03-15 03:12:04 CREDIT accelerator-rate-change -48230.00 USD provider_note: 'retroactive repricing'```
Alice: Provider support ticket note says 'automated retroactive adjustment due to price correction'. But their note also shows we were credited twice: once under 'accelerator-usage' and once under 'commitment-offset'.
Ben: If it's double-applied we need to reconcile before recognizing revenue impact. Can you paste the two line-items (full IDs)?
Diego: IDs: `tx-acc-20260315-A` and `tx-acc-20260315-B`. Both reference invoice `INV-2026-03-1439`.
Claire: Our billing export shows both entries with the same external_adjustment_id — smells like a provider-side duplicate posting.
Alice: I'll open a formal dispute with billing and request a ledger correction. @Ben can you attach the billing_export CSV to the support case? I'll own the ticket.
Ben: On it. Uploading now. Also flagging dedicated capacity team in case this affects committed usage reconciliations. :white_check_mark: 
invoice-bot: Ticket #BILL-9876 created with provider support. Case status: open.
Alice: Thanks. Action items: 1) Ben attach CSV to BILL-9876 2) Finance won't amortize the credit until provider confirms 3) Diego & Claire double-check committed usage match. We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. :calendar:
Claire: Will do. Also, let's add a short guard in our ingestion to dedupe external_adjustment_id to avoid double accounting if the provider repushes. I'll open an infra task.
Diego: Filed ENGINFRA-345 to add a dedupe by external_adjustment_id on billing ingestion pipeline.
Alice: Great. Closing thread pending provider response — keep updates in the ticket. :pray:
